messages.subject: Session about Biological data handling
parts:
Hi everyone,

I would like to give a talk (or a small group seminar) about a package
in R I am using to handle biological sequences (read more here:
http://seqinr.r-forge.r-project.org/).

How could we organise an event like this?
Thanks!

Pau C.

Hi Pau,

Thanks for volunteering to make a talk or small group seminar.

We have nothing planned yet, but for sure yours will be one of next meeting talks. Usually we specify the date of the meeting to go well with the speakers and also a room is available. Also on Thursday at 19h is the usual day.

We will keep in touch and thanks again.

Does anyone else want to make a talk?



Lluís Ramon
